card.name: Punctuation and numbers in antidepressant trial text
card.fires_on: Small pieces of punctuation, spaces and digits inside age ranges, patient counts and suicidality wording in antidepressant trial passages for children and adolescents. Also fires on the start of the name Goldman in a reference list.

modes.label: Age ranges and counts
modes.description: Spaces, hyphens, 'to' and digits within pediatric age ranges or patient totals in trial descriptions.

modes.label: Suicidality warning wording
modes.description: The closing parenthesis after 'suicidality' in the antidepressant warning about children and young adults.
modes.example: suicidal thinking and behavior (suicidality<<)>> in children, adolescents, and young adults

modes.label: Citation author name
modes.description: The first piece of an author's surname in a psychiatry reference list.

card.writes: It suppresses psychology-related words and mildly promotes unrelated tokens, so the output effect is weak.
card.plain: It fires on numbers and punctuation in antidepressant trial text about children, such as age ranges and patient counts.
